scientific_integrity: The all-finite-population-size theorem is proved algebraically by a bounded martingale and a finite-state absorption argument; exact-rational finite checks are supplemental. Prior-work comparisons include residual unindexed dual-locus genealogy risk.
scientific_limitations: Neutral Fermi strength zero; positive independent copying propensities, finite complete population and no mutation. Does not cover nonzero selection, non-complete graphs, or different model individuals for each copied attribute.
title: Exact neutral game–strategy fixation law under coupled imitation
